deviations.justification: The sign test is piecewise constant in the derivative and therefore has zero gradient almost everywhere. A relaxation is the only way to train the three-term objective end to end, and the gap between the two evaluators is measured in execution check E52.
deviations.released_behaviour: Two evaluators are released. The hard evaluator applies the sign test as written and produces every reported descriptor. The soft evaluator replaces the sign-equality indicator with a sigmoid of the consecutive derivative product so that the integrated objective has a gradient; training uses it and inference does not.

deviations.justification: The article names alpha but does not print a value. The default is bounded above by the smallest peak affected fraction the case table reports (0.36), because a declaration cannot follow its own peak.
deviations.released_behaviour: alpha defaults to 0.10 of the examined area.

deviations.justification: The term is named without a norm. Smooth L1 keeps a linear tail for the late declarations that the persistence requirement can produce.
deviations.released_behaviour: Smooth L1 with a half-second transition, applied to the sub-tests that carry a reference onset.

deviations.justification: The article states that the three terms are combined and does not print the weights.
No schedule, optimiser, epoch count, batch size or precision is printed. These are released values and are recorded as engineering defaults rather than as manuscript settings.
deviations.released_behaviour: AdamW, cosine schedule with linear warm-up, 3e-4, weight decay 1e-2, 40 epochs, batch 8, bf16, gradient clipping at 1.0.

deviations.justification: The article states that the threshold is placed at the weighted specificity limit derived from the two error costs and does not print the costs or the floor.
deviations.released_behaviour: The threshold maximises sensitivity subject to a specificity floor of 0.90.

deviations.justification: Only the axial resolution is printed; the area needs both pitches.
deviations.released_behaviour: Lateral pixel pitch equals the printed axial resolution of 15 micrometres.

deviations.justification: The formal statement takes blink events as given. A released pipeline has to obtain them, and the detector is reported so that a reader can replace it.
deviations.released_behaviour: Blinks are detected from a joint contrast collapse and motion spike in the acquisition.

deviations.justification: Written literally, line 12 assigns the loop variable even when the while condition failed, which would place a declaration one frame beyond the epoch it belongs to.
deviations.released_behaviour: A sub-test whose loop variable passes the epoch end is recorded as censored, not as a declaration at the boundary frame.

deviations.justification: The term is described over sub-tests. The model reports one decision per acquisition because the clinical endpoint and the comparator table are both clip-level; the per-sub-test labels are used for the onset term.
deviations.released_behaviour: The decision is formed once per acquisition from the presence of a reference break-up.

deviations.justification: The pretrained prior the article describes is a third-party checkpoint that cannot be redistributed here. The ablation row that depends on it is reported BLOCKED rather than approximated.
deviations.released_behaviour: No pretrained clip checkpoint is shipped. When one is not supplied the trunk trains jointly with the adapter; when one is supplied the trunk is frozen and only the adapter is fitted.

checks.statement: The acquisition source is a robotically acquired anterior-segment stream repurposed into a tear-film measurement.
Break-up is declared only when the deformation derivative stays sign-consistent over a persistence window.

details: record-level repeatability requires the private cohort
checks.statement: The descriptor's coefficient of variation is 34.2% against 51.90 to 65.49% for the reference.

details: record-level onset pairs require the private cohort
checks.statement: The false early rate falls from 4.4% to 0.8%.

details: reader-study readings are not distributed
checks.statement: Clinician review raises the AUC from 0.852 to 0.936 and cuts reading by 17.0%.
The reference instrument carries a coefficient of repeatability larger than the clinical decision window.
A false early break-up moves a mild case into the severe category, so the error that matters is not per-frame perception.
Sampling rate is a floor rather than a gradient: below it an acquisition is invalid, not degraded.

details: site composition is a property of the private table
checks.statement: The retrospective arm covers four sites in two regions.
Acquisition adequacy is the joint sampling and fixation-stability criterion.
The descriptor's within-subject standard deviation, coefficient of repeatability and coefficient of variation are reported before discrimination.
Repeatability is reported as 2.77 Sw.
Agreement is reported with bias, limits of agreement and an intraclass correlation.
Descriptor variance decomposes into a between-site term, a between-session term and an intra-eye term.

details: figure values are derived from the private repeats
checks.statement: The descriptor sits between the structural instruments and the incumbent dynamic reference on the error axis.
Discrimination is measured on a held-out multi-centre split that took no part in training.

details: parity is a property of the fitted models on the private split
checks.statement: The constrained configuration is at parity on primary utility and carries its advantage on the constraint columns.
The frame-pair Siamese and the plain frame classifier are the two published comparators the model is measured against.
The false early rate is the share of eyes declared at least 3 s before the reference.
Cross-site change is the AUC change when a model trained at three sites is applied to a fourth.
Intervals are patient-level cluster bootstraps.
The proposed method is a constrained configuration at parity on primary utility.
Alternative-data rows are the non-invasive dynamic reference and clinician slit-lamp grading.

details: the five fitted runs require the private split
checks.statement: Five independent initialisations give 0.944 with a largest row-to-row dispersion of 0.004.
The proposed configuration costs 78 GFLOPs and 164 ms per clip.
The unconstrained attention baseline costs 214 GFLOPs and 268 ms per clip.

details: component deltas require the five fitted ablations
checks.statement: Removing the fast deformation branch costs 0.047 in AUC.

details: component deltas require the five fitted ablations
checks.statement: Removing the slow persistence branch costs 0.032 and lifts the false early rate from 0.8% to 4.4%.

details: component deltas require the five fitted ablations
checks.statement: Removing the structural branch costs 0.008 and removing the adequacy gate 0.003.

details: calibration error is measured on the private split
checks.statement: The repeatability-aware head buys calibration rather than discrimination: 0.004 in AUC but 0.031 to 0.052 in calibration error.
Removing both temporal branches returns 0.838 against a sum of individual losses of 0.079, an interaction ratio of 1.34.

details: substitution rows require the fitted ablation
checks.statement: Substituting mean pooling for the persistence branch returns 0.903.

details: substitution rows require the fitted ablation
checks.statement: Substituting a 2019-generation 3D convolutional backbone for the fast branch returns 0.918.

details: matched-budget retraining requires the private split
checks.statement: The attentional baseline retrained under a matched budget reaches 0.929 with a false early rate of 3.6%.

details: tertiles are defined on the private reader study
checks.statement: The model's added value is largest where pre-intervention inter-clinician agreement is lowest.
Site-level results are reported per site and pooled, with between-site heterogeneity.
Dry eye is defined by a break-up time at or below 5 s together with a symptom score above 13.
Severity kappa is reported within each severity stratum as well as per site.

details: stratum results require the private table
checks.statement: Discrimination falls from the mild to the severe stratum.
The failure taxonomy has three categories: residual post-blink artefacts, marginal fixation stability, and concurrent ocular-surface pathology.

details: prospective records are not distributed
checks.statement: The completed prospective arm reproduces the retrospective result under a locked model.
Adequacy is the proportion of attempted acquisitions meeting the joint criterion, and abstentions are excluded from performance estimates.
The reader study is a three-arm fully crossed design with a five-week washout.
The assisted-minus-unaided difference is tested with readers and cases as random factors.
Reliance and under-reliance are measured over the discordant reads.

details: reader experience is recorded in the private study
checks.statement: The gain is largest for the least experienced readers.

details: reading times are recorded in the private study
checks.statement: Reading time falls from 62.4 s to 51.8 s per case.

details: reader ratings are not distributed
checks.statement: Inter-reader kappa rises from 0.61 to 0.74.
The locked model runs in silent mode alongside the standard assessment.

details: abstention counts require the prospective records
checks.statement: Abstention is 2.5% and requires no additional clinical action.
The clinical threshold is placed from the relative cost of the two error paths, not by aggregating them.

details: drift requires the prospective time series
checks.statement: Recalibration drift over the prospective accrual is bounded by a single estimate.
Each expert case is reported with declared onset, peak affected fraction, reference onset and outcome.

details: case-level acquisition is not distributed
checks.statement: Case 3 abstains because fixation stability sits outside the acceptance band.

details: case-level acquisition is not distributed
checks.statement: Case 5 is a genuine false early break-up from a residual post-blink speck.
The mechanistic arm compares hyperosmolar and iso-osmolar corneal epithelial cultures.

details: the replicate table is not distributed
checks.statement: Secreted mediator changes are reported with 95% intervals over three independent experiments.
The study has two clinical arms and one non-comparative external cohort.
The partition is implemented at the patient level.
The platform uses an axial resolution around 15 micrometres.
The structural descriptor resolves the meniscus into 25 to 100 elements.
The adequacy floor is 30 frames per second and is an inclusion criterion.
The reference standards are non-invasive break-up time, meniscus height and volume, staining grade and the Ocular Surface Disease Index.
The objective has three terms: a break-up decision, an onset regression and a repeatability penalty.
The fast branch reads at most five consecutive frames.
The derivative is D_t = d_t phi(x_t).
The persistence operator keeps loci whose derivative sign is constant on the window and only after the window has expired.
Break-up is declared at the first moment the sign-consistent area reaches alpha of the examined area.
The instability curve is the occupied fraction of the examined area.
The persistence window is fixed at 0.17 s.
The descriptor is the six-tuple of onset, peak instability, slope, locus entropy, meniscus height and meniscus area.
The descriptor head adjusts the measurement with variance components under one standard across sites.
Adequacy is evaluated before any inference, and the artefact channel is produced inside the blink-to-blink loop.
Calibration follows descriptor collection and is fitted on repeated measurements of the same eyes.
The inference path is decomposed into six stages that sum to the reported total.
Twelve readers in three experience groups read every case twice under a five-week washout.
Holm's step-down method controls multiplicity over the primary criteria.
The four pre-specified criteria are an assisted AUC of at least 0.92, a gain of at least 0.05, a false early rate of at most 1.0% and a coefficient of variation of at most 45%.
The mechanistic arm is in vitro only, with no animal work and no new human specimens.
The private clinical cohort cannot be redistributed; the derived quantities are available on request.
